classic.name: Classic massage
classic.description: A relaxing full-body or targeted massage that eases tension and improves circulation.

sports.name: Sports massage
sports.description: For athletes and active people — before exertion, after training or during recovery.

therapeutic.name: Therapeutic massage
therapeutic.description: Deep-tissue work focused on pain, tight muscles and restricted mobility.

cupping.name: Cupping massage
cupping.description: Cups release the fascia, improve blood flow and speed up muscle recovery.

triggerPoint.name: Trigger point therapy
triggerPoint.description: Targeted pressure on trigger points that cause local or referred pain.

posture.name: Posture analysis
posture.description: A look at your posture and movement to find the causes of tension and pain, and to tailor further sessions.

faq.metaDescription: How to book a massage, how to prepare and what to tell me before we start — Budja Reset Center, Škofljica.
faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know before your first massage.

a: Pick a slot online or send me a DM on Instagram.
In your message, tell me what's bothering you or what you'd like, which length you want (30, 60 or 90 min) and which day suits you. We then agree on a time together.
Before every massage I take time for a short conversation. It matters to me that I understand what you need, so together we choose the best approach.
Every session is tailored to the individual.
The massage is done in underwear or short sports shorts.
I recommend a bra you can unclip, so the back is easy to reach while your comfort and privacy are kept.
Please remove all jewellery before the massage and arrive fresh and showered. Everything else you need is ready in the studio.

health.q: What should I tell you before we start?
a: Before we start, you must tell me about any health problems, injuries, pain, surgery, pregnancy, medication or other circumstances that could affect the massage.
Your safety and well-being come first.

duration.q: How long does a massage take?
a: Sessions are 30, 60 or 90 minutes. You'll find the prices in the price list.
Yes, free parking is available in front of the studio.
